claims.quote: Microcephaly, epilepsy, and developmental delay (MCSZ) is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder associated with autosomal recessive inheritance of mutations in the polynucleotide kinase 3'-phosphatase (PNKP) gene.

claims.object_text: fetal microcephaly with a gradual decline in head circumference
claims.quote: In this case, prenatal screening in the second trimester detected fetal microcephaly with a gradual decline in head circumference, prompting the decision to terminate the pregnancy.
Subsequent genetic analysis of the fetal tissue confirmed the presence of compound heterozygous mutations in the PNKP gene.
The patient carried the heterozygous c.1188 + 1G > A PNKP mutation
her husband carried the heterozygous c.976G > A PNKP mutation

claims.object_text: compound heterozygous mutations c.976G > A and c.1188 + 1G > A
claims.quote: The fetus was found to have compound heterozygous mutations c.976G > A and c.1188 + 1G > A.
